units.source_text: 龙枝，你觉着奇怪的事，其实并不奇怪。

en.t: Ryushi, what you feel is strange is not really strange at all.

units.source_text: 读了你的信，我是多么震惊啊。

en.t: When I read your letter, how deeply shocked I was.

units.source_text: 我不由得想，哦，原来她是如此深沉地爱着我。

en.t: I could not help thinking, ah, so she loves me this deeply after all.

units.source_text: 我相信，你的灵魂真的来到了我的身边，所以你才这样了解房间的情况。

en.t: I believe that your soul truly came to my side, and that is why you understand the room so well.

units.source_text: 既然如此，我想：灵魂既然真的来了，哪能只有身子不来呢？

en.t: Since that is so, I thought: if the soul has truly come, how could only the body fail to come?

units.source_text: 我这才产生了自信和勇气写这封信给你，让你弃家到我这儿来。

en.t: Only then did I gain the confidence and courage to write this letter to you, asking you to leave your home and come to me.

units.source_text: 你还没见到我，就梦见了我。

en.t: Before you had even met me, you dreamed of me.

units.source_text: 这不正说明我们的命运是息息相关的吗？

en.t: Does this not show that our destinies are closely bound together?
